question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched authority within the Chinese Communist Party, reinforced by repeated military and elite purges through early 2026, underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. These actions, including the ouster of senior generals previously viewed as loyal, have further centralized control over the People’s Liberation Army and party institutions ahead of the 21st Party Congress. No viable alternative leadership bloc or succession mechanism has emerged to challenge his position as general secretary and Central Military Commission chairman. While health concerns or abrupt elite fractures remain theoretically possible triggers for change, verifiable developments show sustained dominance rather than erosion of power.
